paragraphs: Recent research indicates that remote work can enhance employee productivity (Smith & Lee, 2021). But the impact seems to vary based on the type of task and the availability of supervision.
412 knowledge workers surveyed: 68% experienced improved concentration working from home 41% found it challenging to "turn off" after work
Which shows that the increases in productivity are not necessarily true for all.
Smith, J., & Lee, K. (2021). Remote work and productivity. Journal of Work, 12(3), 45-60.
